design.electrodes: the grid column holding the largest |MUAP| of the unit in the released straight tensor (5 rows) + the centre electrode

harmonic_bed.junction_rule: long_fibers placement: NMJ at the streamline sample nearest the IZ plane; a streamline that does not reach the plane gets its NMJ at its nearer end (f2_common.harmonic_bed_at_iz)

design.matched_unit_rule: the unit's `size` nearest streamlines to the released centre in the mid-z plane (z = 165.1 mm) — the pool's own territory rule
design.fullspan_variant: the same rule restricted to the 692 streamlines that reach the IZ plane; re-synthesized for the units whose fibre set changes: [40, 45, 82, 86, 94, 95, 97, 99]
design.innervation: NMJ on the straight bed's IZ plane (z = 126.1 mm) on both beds; jitter N(0, 4.07 mm) = IZ_JITTER × mean straight fibre length, per-MU seed = MU index
design.recipe: direct line-source synthesis: field_to_muap with f2_common.SPCFG ({'butterworth_cutoff': 0.03, 'butterworth_order': 2, 'edge_taper_left': 5, 'edge_taper_right': 10, 'upsample_factor': 2, 'denoise': 'monopole', 'denoise_n_poles': 3, 'fiber_window': 'one_sided', 'tukey_alpha': 0.25, 'v': 4.0, 'sigma_in': 1.0, 'fiber_radius_mm': 0.05, 'polarity': 1, 'csd_derivative': 2, 'fsamp': 2048.0, 'w': 256, 'center_time': False, 't_start_ms': -10.0}), φ sampled along each fibre path with per-fibre arc-length dz

truncated_group.rule: < 90% of the unit's streamlines reach the IZ plane

eof_definition.rule: EOF: max|m| for t > t_arr + LOBE over max|m| within ±LOBE of t_arr, centre electrode; onset: max|m| for −1 ≤ t ≤ 3 ms over the same lobe amplitude

truncated_streamlines.note: all start distal to the IZ plane on the deep (large-x) side of the muscle; their NMJ is placed at that proximal end
